Base UI line variant of TabsList does not draw lines (shadcn styling only, not used here)
Incorrect rendering of Tabs with Base UI (listing title only, details not read)
Tabs helper dedupe PR, performance only

notChecked: Reddit, Hacker News and blog searches

differences.reference: Radix renders a native disabled attribute; arrow keys and End skip the item
differences.branch: Base UI renders aria-disabled=true only; arrow keys and End move focus onto the disabled item (disabled stays focusable); Enter on it does nothing
differences.how: Focus Home, press ArrowRight 3 times: focus lands on Disabled (Radix: Search). Press End: Disabled (Radix: Inbox).

differences.reference: opacity 0.4, pointer-events none (disabled: variant matches the native attribute)
differences.branch: opacity 1, pointer-events auto, because the disabled: variant no longer matches; would need data-disabled: classes
differences.how: Compare computed opacity of the 'Disabled' tab in the first demo.

differences.branch: focus ring drawn around the disabled item when reached by keyboard
differences.how: Same as the first difference, screenshot after ArrowRight x3.

differences.reference: tablist tabindex=0 with all tabs tabindex=-1; tabs carry aria-controls pointing at nonexistent content ids; disabled tab has the disabled attribute
differences.branch: tablist has no tabindex, selected tab has tabindex=0 (roving), no aria-controls, disabled tab has aria-disabled=true and no disabled attribute, extra data-activation-direction attributes
differences.how: Inspect the DOM of #bottom-navigation in both builds.

differences.reference: ArrowRight from Search lands on Inbox
differences.branch: sequence includes Disabled; ArrowRight from it wraps to Home

apiChanges: Trigger becomes Tab; activationMode='manual' dropped (Base UI default is manual: arrows only moved focus); data-[state=active] becomes data-active; onValueChange also receives eventDetails (consumers ignore it)
notes: Gates not run because the swap was reverted after the comparison. The browser window would not resize (stayed 500x701), so screenshots are 500x701 only, not 1280x900 or 390x844, and only the gallery bottom-navigation section was exercised. The gallery mobile tab bar and boilerplate gallery were not compared (not checked); they use the same component with no disabled items, so the tabindex/aria differences apply to them too. Tab/Shift+Tab order, hover/press and reduced motion not checked. Computed sizes (102x52 items) and colors matched.
reasonNotMoved: Base UI Tabs keeps disabled tabs focusable (aria-disabled, no native disabled), so arrow keys and End land on the disabled item, a focus ring appears on it, and with the current classes it loses its 0.4 opacity and pointer-events:none. Roving tabindex and ARIA attributes also differ from Radix (tablist tabindex, aria-controls, disabled attribute). Retry if Base UI offers a skip-disabled option (or the project accepts disabled-but-focusable) and item styling is moved to data-disabled: classes, then re-run keyboard and screenshot comparison at 1280x900 and 390x844, including the gallery mobile tab bar.
